title: Lab Order Checklist
subtitle: Capture authenticated order, test code, specimen, and collection window; confirm result route and cancellation.
description: Lab Order records authenticated order, test code, specimen, collection window, result route, and cancellation. Lab Order evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this lab order stage-gated verification when staff must document authenticated order and test code. Reconcile specimen, collection window, result route, and cancellation before the lab order handoff. Use the authenticated requisition, ordered test list, diagnosis or reason source as allowed, specimen requirement, collection window, laboratory destination, and cancellation log. Ask the assigned lab order reviewer to confirm authenticated order against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Lab Order starting details
sections.guidance: Record ordering professional, test names or codes, specimen and handling, fasting or timing requirement, collection window, result routing, standing-order limit, and cancellation. Keep any urgent lab order issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Lab Order checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current lab order facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Lab Order required checks
items: Authenticated order is identified for this record
Test code matches the current request or source
Specimen is ready for point-of-use staff
Collection window limits or questions are resolved
Result route is communicated to the responsible person

blocks.label: Lab Order failed or pending items

sections.title: Lab Order decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold lab order readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Lab Order reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Lab Order receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
